sources.excerpt: Tone Secret Overdrive | vertexeffects.com Home About Products All Pedals Doctor's Special Pedalboards Power Supply --> Amplifiers Discontinued Retailers Support Order Tracking Warranty Contact us Wah Redemption Rig Doctor Create Account Log in Home About Products All Pedals Doctor's Special Pedalboards Power Supply --> Amplifiers Discontinued Retailers Support Order Tracking Warranty Contact us Wah Redemption Rig Doctor Follow Us Information Articles Newsletter Warranty Order Tracking --> Delivery and returns --> Wah Redemption --> Contact us Where to Find Us Vertex Effects Inc. 2355 Westwood Blvd. #1277 Los Angeles, CA 90064 USA Vertex Effects Inc. © 2026 About Team Locations Privacy Terms --> Home About Products All Pedals Doctor's Special Pedalboards Power Supply --> Amplifiers Discontinued Retailers Support Order Tracking Warranty Contact us Wah Redemption Rig Doctor Tone Secret OD 4.5 Tone Secret OD 4.5 BUY ON BUY ON BUY ON Lifetime warranty 30-DAY money back guarantee return policy Features include DNA of a classic "Screamer" hitting a "Blackface" 12AX7 preamp Über versatile drive voicing with Pre-Vol, Grit, & Master Vol controls True Bypass Designed in California 9VDC center-negative power operation (adapter not included) Submit Review × --> Send Description Reviews Articles Manuals Description The Tone Secret (TS) is the answer to the love/hate relationship countless guitarists have with a particular screaming green overdrive pedal that originated in late 1970’s Japan. The Tone Secret recreates the sonic DNA of the most iconic users of the green screamer heard on countless studio recordings and live performances without the need for a cranked mid-scooped amplifier to run the pedal into. The TS only utilizes 50% of the gain found in a traditional green OD pedal; however, the added pre-overdrive and post overdrive controls allow you to tweak the OD characteristics to match any amplifier and simulate amp break-up without dime-ing the “DRIVE” knob on your pedal. Additionally, we’ve added individual controls for treble and mid-range frequencies, along with our “GRIT” control to dial in the ratio of your amp’s natural break-up in tandem with the overdrive produced by the Tone Secret. If you’re looking for a screaming OD pedal that nails the classic and contemporary sounds heard on your favorite records, look no further than the Tone Secret. The Tone Secret recreates the tonal DNA of the Green Screamer's most famous users, heard on countless studio recordings and live performances, without requiring a fully maxed out amp guy to engage the pedal. It uses only 50% of the gain of a conventional green OD pedal. With the addition of Pre-Overdrive and Post-Overdrive controls, you can match the OD characteristics to any amp and simulate amp distortion without pushing the “DRIVE” button on your pedal. Additionally, we've added individual controls for treble and mid frequencies, as well as our GRIT control to adjust the relationship between the amp and the overdrive produced by the Tone Secret.If you're looking for a good overdrive pedal that will reproduce the classic and contemporary sounds of your favorite records, look no further than the Tone Secret.
